WITH patient_level AS (
  SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.ALB) as patient_avg_alb,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN l.UN IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` IS NOT NULL AND l.`T-BIL` != 0.0
      THEN CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / l.`T-BIL` 
    END) as patient_avg_un_tbil_ratio
  FROM Patient p
  INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX != ''
  GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX
),
sex_level AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    AVG(patient_avg_alb) as sex_avg_alb,
    AVG(patient_avg_un_tbil_ratio) as sex_avg_un_tbil_ratio
  FROM patient_level
  GROUP BY SEX
),
mean_alb AS (
  SELECT AVG(sex_avg_alb) as overall_mean_alb
  FROM sex_level
)
SELECT 
  s.SEX,
  s.sex_avg_alb,
  s.sex_avg_un_tbil_ratio,
  s.sex_avg_alb - m.overall_mean_alb as above_mean
FROM sex_level s
CROSS JOIN mean_alb m
WHERE s.sex_avg_alb > m.overall_mean_alb
ORDER BY s.SEX
